parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter rules for the component.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-ops-items --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 50 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ3NjFENDdB --filter '[{"Operator":"Equal","Value":["Open"],"Name":"Status"}]' --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --resource-tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListOpsItems --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ3NjFENDdB --ResourceTags '{"k1":"v1","k2":"v2"}' --Filter.1.Value.1 Open --MaxResults 50 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Operator Equal --Filter.1.Name Status --Tags '{"k1":"v1","k2":"v2"}'
